title: GAX-P08 - MedAgentBench public corpus and external runtime qualification
outcome: Qualify or block the frozen MedAgentBench public corpus independently from the external official runtime/scorer, freeze the public benchmark as final-test-only, and preserve sealed P08 final-test access.
rationale: MedAgentBench is a high-value EHR-agent benchmark, but its public MIT repository does not contain the full official scoring/runtime surface: upstream requires a Docker-hosted FHIR environment and a separately downloaded refsol.py. GAX must distinguish reproducible public corpus identity from official-runtime reproducibility and rights rather than treating public accessibility as permission.
scope_in: Frozen MedAgentBench repository and public task/function file identity verification
Final-test-only role manifest for the complete published task corpus
Exact and normalized near-duplicate audit over model-visible task text
Dedicated zero-founder-cost GitHub Actions qualification path
Byte-for-byte regenerated-versus-committed evidence drift enforcement after freeze
P08 inventory update only to the evidence-supported compound state
scope_out: No GAX or baseline model inference
No training/calibration/model-selection use of MedAgentBench test supervision
No founder-paid compute, API, Docker hosting, or FHIR hosting
No redistribution of patient-environment artifacts from GAX
No copying of raw task text, gold outputs, patient identifiers, or FHIR payloads into GAX evidence
No assumption that repository MIT terms cover Docker image contents or refsol.py
No official MedAgentBench success-rate claim while runtime/scorer remains blocked
No clinical-safety, FHIR-conformance, agent-superiority, or SOTA claim

Repository is pinned to stanfordmlgroup/MedAgentBench commit 99260117137b09f04837a8c18d18a1107efa55ae
Task corpus is pinned to data/medagentbench/test_data_v2.json Git blob 7f568f041f9d22e11b5bf31b80efd2219aaaf14f and 118276 bytes
Function catalog is pinned to data/medagentbench/funcs_v1.json Git blob 9b15acc0ccf402ede8964261c371d6a00889b436 and 12571 bytes
Frozen source qualification records raw SHA-256 digests without committing upstream raw files
Committed evidence contains no raw task text, gold values, MRNs, DOBs, patient names, or FHIR payloads

The complete published task corpus is final-test-only and cannot be used for training, calibration, prompt selection, threshold selection, ECAL selection, FHIR representation selection, or model selection

The persisted leakage-audit payload must hash exactly to the qualification report audit SHA-256
Public-benchmark/pretraining contamination remains unresolved and disclosed

Upstream Docker reference jyxsu6/medagentbench:latest is recorded as a mutable external runtime reference unless an immutable digest is separately established
The Stanford Medicine Box refsol.py dependency is recorded separately; immutable revision and license remain unverified unless independent evidence proves them

Official MedAgentBench success-rate claims remain forbidden while external runtime/scorer status is blocked

required_for_authorization remains true and is not relaxed merely to clear blockers
Overall P08 final-test access remains sealed
Exact-head Linux/Windows Python 3.11/3.12 CI and dedicated frozen-source qualification pass before merge
Implementation merges with an expected-head guard
Post-main CI/qualification pass
A separate canonical closeout is required before SG-000016 becomes PROVEN

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000016 files and retain MedAgentBench as pending/blocked. P08 final-test access remains sealed and no model result is generated in this grain.
